summary: Advanced Flower Capital Inc. filed a Form 8-K on September 29, 2026, reporting entry into Amendment Number Ten to its Loan and Security Agreement dated April 29, 2022, effective September 25, 2026, with the borrower, lenders, lead arranger, bookrunner and administrative agent. The amendment sets advance-rate conditions against borrower-base credit facilities, revises the loan fee structure, and temporarily increases aggregate revolver commitments to $130 million via up to $50 million quarterly temporary increases, reverting to $80 million otherwise. The filing also creates a direct financial obligation disclosure; no board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation transaction is involved. What to watch: funding flexibility and credit terms, not deal arbitrage.
